newsitem.title: JAPAN: Aoki says put up reserves for guaranteed loans.
newsitem.headline: Aoki says put up reserves for guaranteed loans.

text.p: Aoki Corp said on Friday that it has already put aside loan-loss reserves for loans it has guaranteed which carry a risk of default.
A company spokesman said debts on which the company had provided guarantees totalled 285.2 billion yen as of March 31, 1997, compared with 289.0 billion yen a year earlier.
The debts are held by Aoki affiliates and other firms involved in the contractor's real-estate development projects.
"We have already increased reserves for guaranteed loans with possible risks," said the spokesman.
Shares in the Japanese construction firm slipped on the Tokyo Stock Exchange in Friday morning as investors worried about the company's financial health.
The shares were down 20 yen at 80 yen at 0122 GMT.
